Du entwickelst es laufend weiter und verbesserst es iterativ. Du entwickelst die Screening- und Priorisierungslogik für Targets und verbesserst deren Trefferqualität systematisch. Du baust die automatisierte Datenbeschaffung und -anreicherung aus, sodass Targets angereichert werden mit Firmographics und Eigentümerstrukturen. Du entwickelst Logik und Workflows, um Intent-Signale und potenzielles Verkaufsinteresse zu erkennen. Du initiierst die automatisierte Multichannel-Ansprache und entwickelst die zugrunde liegenden Prozesse weiter. Du baust Dashboards und Reports zu Funnel, Aktivitäten und Conversion als Grundlage unserer Sourcing- und Pipeline-Reviews. Du evaluierst neue Prospecting- und Sourcing-Tools und entwickelst Ansprache, Sequenzen und unsere Messaging-Bibliothek weiter. Dein Profil Du hast eigene Tools und Automatisierungen gebaut, die produktiv im Einsatz waren, nicht nur Prototypen und Demos. Du bringst mindestens 2–3 Jahre Erfahrung im Aufbau AI-basierter Produkte/Tools mit. Du entwickelst selbstständig in Python und deployst mit Docker auf Azure in Produktion. Du kennst LLM-APIs (OpenAI, Claude) aus der Praxis und weißt, wo sie zuverlässig funktionieren und wo (noch) nicht. Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Daten und weißt, worauf es bei Datenqualität und -struktur ankommt. Kenntnisse in Pipedrive, Agentensystemen sowie Frameworks wie LangGraph sind ein Plus. Du denkst kommerziell: Du verstehst, warum ein Target relevant ist und misst dich an Ergebnissen. Du hast ein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Data Analytics, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren MINT-Fach erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch. Benefits Raum zum Wachsen und die Möglichkeit, viel Verantwortung zu übernehmen, kombiniert mit halbjährlichem Feedback und einem individuellen Weiterbildungsbudget. Persönliche und berufliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch ein inspirierendes und dynamisches Umfeld und flache Hierarchien. Regelmäßige Events, ein gemeinsamer Sommerurlaub sowie verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote wie beispielsweise zweimonatliche Massage / Physiotherapie im Büro. Moderne und ergonomische Arbeitsmittel, ein Office im Herzen Berlins direkt am Park am Gleisdreieck sowie eine voll ausgestattete Küche mit gesunden Snacks, Softdrinks und einem monatlichen Friday Beer/Sekt/Wein. title: Data Scientist / Data Engineer
description: 80 Beats Medical is a Berlin-based medical technology company developing innovative solutions for cardiovascular and vascular diagnostics. Our VICORDER® platform enables non-invasive assessment of vascular health Building on this established technology, we are expanding our clinical diagnostic portfolio by combining medical device technology with advanced data analytics and AI. Our goal is to transform complex physiological and cardiovascular data into reliable, clinically meaningful insights that can support earlier risk detection and better-informed clinical decisions. We are a growing, international team working at the intersection of medical devices, software, data science, and clinical research. We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist / Data Engineer to help build the data and AI infrastructure behind our next generation of medical diagnostic solutions. You will work with high-frequency physiological and clinical data, developing secure and scalable data pipelines and supporting the transition of machine learning models from research into production-ready clinical applications. You will work closely with our software, clinical, and regulatory teams in a highly interdisciplinary environment. Tasks Design, build, and maintain robust, scalable, and secure data ingestion and transformation pipelines. Implement automated ingestion, validation, lineage tracking, and quality monitoring. Develop and maintain reusable data libraries, transformation logic, and governance frameworks. Ensure full compliance with GDPR, NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act (EU), HIPAA (US) and other global regulatory frameworks. Experience with implementation of Role-based access control (RBAC), Encryption in transit and at rest (HSM/KMS), Data anonymization & pseudonymization workflows and Consent handling and audit mechanisms. Participate in security audits, compliance reviews, and certification efforts. Operationalize AI pipelines including model deployment, monitoring, drift handling, versioning, and automated retraining. Deploy explainable AI tooling (SHAP/LIME) into the pipeline for auditability and compliance. Maintain CI/CD workflows for data and ML workloads. Develop Python-based analytics scripts, reusable data modules, and feature engineering logic. Support visualization of workflows. Ensure reproducibility and model traceability across the full lifecycle. Requirements QUALIFICATIONS Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data science, AI, Cybersecurity, or similar. 5+ years of experience building secure, compliant cloud-based data ecosystems ( for regulated data domains. Hands-on experience with time-series data, sensor data, or biomedical/wearable data. Knowledge of statistical programming Strong understanding of ML approaches for classification, anomaly detection, and prediction using high-frequency data. Proficiency in one or more programming languages Advanced experience with Orchestration, Data frameworks, and Infrastructure automation. Proven cross-functional communication skills. Our VICORDER® platform enables non-invasive assessment of vascular health Building on this established technology, we are expanding our clinical diagnostic portfolio by combining medical device technology with advanced data analytics and AI.

We are a growing, international team working at the intersection of medical devices, software, data science, and clinical research.

We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist / Data Engineer to help build the data and AI infrastructure behind our next generation of medical diagnostic solutions. You will work closely with our software, clinical, and regulatory teams in a highly interdisciplinary environment.

Tasks

  • Develop and maintain reusable data libraries, transformation logic, and governance frameworks.
  • Ensure full compliance with GDPR, NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act (EU), HIPAA (US) and other global regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience with implementation of Role-based access control (RBAC), Encryption in transit and at rest (HSM/KMS), Data anonymization & pseudonymization workflows and Consent handling and audit mechanisms.
  • Participate in security audits, compliance reviews, and certification efforts.
  • Operationalize AI pipelines including model deployment, monitoring, drift handling, versioning, and automated retraining.
  • Deploy explainable AI tooling (SHAP/LIME) into the pipeline for auditability and compliance.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows for data and ML workloads.
  • Develop Python-based analytics scripts, reusable data modules, and feature engineering logic.
  • Support visualization of workflows.

QUALIFICATIONS

title: Senior Associate (European Competition practice) - m/f/d
description: <p><strong>About Charles River Associates</strong></p> <p><a href="https://www.crai.com">Charles River Associates</a> is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analyses that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.</p> <p>CRA's <a href="https://www.crai.com/services/antitrust-and-competition/ecp/">European Competition practice</a> specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings: &nbsp;firms considering merger and acquisition opportunities or involved in merger control proceedings; and firms undergoing investigations relating to cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, abuse of dominance or state aid. &nbsp;We also provide advice to firms involved in regulatory proceedings and sector inquiries. We offer assistance on the estimation effects of damages in cartel cases, international arbitration and intellectual property disputes.</p> <p><strong>Position Overview</strong></p> <p>The Senior Associate position is the entry-level position for applicants with a PhD in Economics and limited work experience. The Senior Associate position is also open to applicants with a Master of Economics and at least 3 years of relevant work experience, within economic consulting or with a competition authority. Candidates will be expected to rapidly take on genuine responsibility, working closely with senior consultants, scholars and industry experts on project teams, and will have the opportunity to immediately work on some of the largest, high-profile and most significant competition cases in Europe, providing conceptual and practical input to projects. description: About the Role at RobCo RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works. At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious Working Student – Go-to-Market Engineering (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions. As part of the Revenue team, you will help design and implement systems that enable our sales team to operate more efficiently and scale outreach in a structured way. You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Operations to build automations, outbound workflows, and data pipelines that power our go-to-market strategy. You will be expected to work autonomously, think creatively, and find innovative solutions to process and system challenges. Your Responsibilities Sales Automation & Outreach: Build and optimize outreach sequences and messaging workflows for the Sales team, support the development of scalable outbound systems for account-based sales, and test and improve cold email performance and targeting logic. Think creatively to find new ways to reach prospects and improve conversion. Revenue Operations & Systems: Maintain and optimize our CRM workflows in HubSpot, build automations and integrations between GTM tools using Zapier, support lead routing, enrichment, and pipeline automation, and propose innovative solutions to improve workflow efficiency. GTM Data & Automation: Build data enrichment and prospecting workflows using Clay, help structure and maintain prospect and account data, and create scalable prospecting pipelines and enrichment processes. Work independently to develop new automation approaches. Outbound Infrastructure: Support the setup and maintenance of outbound infrastructure with tools like Smartlead, assist with domain setup, deliverability monitoring, and campaign tracking, and bring creative ideas to optimize campaigns and sequences. Process & Analytics: Analyze outreach and pipeline performance, identify bottlenecks in the sales funnel and propose automation improvements, and document and improve GTM processes. We're looking for someone who has: Currently enrolled at a university (Business, Engineering, Data, or a similar field) Strong interest in Revenue Operations, Sales Automation, or Growth Systems Analytical mindset and curiosity for how systems and workflows work Creative, solution-oriented, and autonomous approach to problem-solving Structured way of working and ability to take ownership of projects Good written and spoken English Ideally, hands-on experience with tools such as HubSpot, Clay, Zapier, or Smartlead Interest in Sales Tech, RevOps, or GTM Engineering is a strong plus Basic understanding of outbound sales or B2B SaaS sales processes is beneficial Experience with data tools, APIs, or no-code automation platforms is a bonus Why join RobCo? Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation. Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time. As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work. Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development. Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership. Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home. Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest. About RobCo Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model. We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco. Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements. title: Senior Manager Project Finance (m/w/d) – BESS & Infrastructure
description: Über uns Wir sind ju:niz Energy – seit mehr als einem Jahrzehnt Pionierin für netzdienliche Batteriegroßspeicher. Von der Projektentwicklung über Bau und Vermarktung bis zum langfristigen Betrieb verbinden wir alle entscheidenden Kompetenzen unter einem Dach. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden BESS-Plattformen Deutschlands aufzubauen und die Energiewende mit leistungsstarker Speicherinfrastruktur messbar voranzubringen. Ob ein Speicherprojekt gebaut werden kann, entscheidet sich nicht nur an Technologie und Genehmigung, sondern auch an einer robusten, bankfähigen Finanzierung. Als Senior Manager Project Finance verantwortest du eigenständig die Strukturierung, Verhandlung und den Abschluss von Fremdfinanzierungen für unsere Greenfield- und Akquisitionsprojekte. Du führst Finanzierungen hands-on vom ersten Bankkontakt bis zum Financial Close und verbindest Banken, Investoren, Berater sowie unsere internen Teams. Deine Aufgaben Du strukturierst, verhandelst und schließt Projektfinanzierungen für BESS-Anlagen eigenständig ab – von der Bankenansprache und dem Term Sheet bis zur Unterzeichnung und zum Financial Close. Conditions Precedent und Conditions Subsequent steuerst du ebenso verlässlich wie Kreditverträge, Sicherheiten Pakete und Intercreditor Agreements gemeinsam mit Banken und externen Rechtsberatern. Belastbare Bankbeziehungen baust du aktiv aus und koordinierst Lender Due Diligence, Datenräume, Q&A-Prozesse sowie Technical, Legal, Insurance und Model Advisors. Die Bankfähigkeit zentraler Projektverträge wie EPC, O&M, Netzanschluss, PPAs oder Tolling Agreements und Landpacht stellst du frühzeitig mit Legal, Development und Delivery sicher. Komplexe Projektfinanzierungsmodelle entwickelst und pflegst du eigenständig – inklusive CFADS, DSCR, LLCR, IRR, Equity Return, DebtSculpting sowie Base, Bank und Downside Cases. Nach dem Closing verantwortest du Fremdfinanzierungscontrolling, Covenant Monitoring, Reserve Accounts und Bankreporting und entwickelst bei Risiken passende Waiver-,Reprofiling- oder Reforecast-Maßnahmen. Akquisitions- und Investitionsentscheidungen unterstützt du mit Finanzierungsindikationen, Business Cases und FID-Analysen und wirkst an unserer langfristigen Finanzierungs- und Investitionsstrategie mit. Dein Profil Du hast ein wirtschaftswissenschaftliches oder vergleichbares Studium abgeschlossen und verfügst über fünf bis zehn Jahre Erfahrung in Project Finance, Infrastructure Finance oder Transaction Advisory für erneuerbare Energien. Mehrere non-recourse Projektfinanzierungen hast du nachweislich hands-on von der Term-Sheet-Phase bis zum Financial Close strukturiert und erfolgreich abgeschlossen. CFADS, DSCR, LLCR, Debt Sculpting, Covenants, Cash Sweeps, Reserve Accounts sowie CP- und CS-Management beherrschst du fachlich sicher. LMA-basierte Kreditverträge, Sicherheitenpakete und Intercreditor Agreements kannst du verhandlungssicher beurteilen und gemeinsam mit Rechtsberatern zum Abschluss führen. Excel nutzt du auf Expertenniveau und baust komplexe Projektfinanzierungsmodelle selbstständig auf; Szenario- und Sensitivitätsanalysen gehören zu deinem täglichen Handwerkszeug. Lender Due Diligence und externe Berater steuerst du souverän. Erfahrung mit BESS-Revenue-Streams, dem deutschen Regulierungsrahmen sowie M&A- oder Co-Investment-Strukturen ist ein starkes Plus. Du verbindest Ownership, Pragmatismus und Verhandlungsstärke mit sehr gutem Deutsch und Englisch auf Verhandlungsniveau. Für die enge Zusammenarbeit bist du regelmäßig an unserem Standort in Aschheim bei München präsent. Warum wir? Direkter Einfluss darauf, welche großen Batteriespeicherprojekte in Deutschland finanziert und gebaut werden. End-to-End-Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Finanzierungen mit echter Entscheidungs- und Gestaltungsfreiheit. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Management, Banken, Investoren und unserem Shareholder EQT. Ein ambitioniertes Wachstumsumfeld mit dem Ziel, bis 2030 1,5 GW in Betrieb zu bringen und zu den Top 3 in Deutschland zu gehören. Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket aus Fixgehalt und Bonus sowie flexible Zusammenarbeit mit regelmäßigem persönlichem Austausch. Kontakt Bewirb dich jetzt – auch wenn dein Lebenslauf nicht alle Punkte erfüllt. Entscheidend sind Motivation, Potenzial und dein Wille, die Energiewende aktiv mitzugestalten. Wir freuen uns ausdrücklich über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen. Gemeinsam schaffen wir ein Umfeld, in dem jeder sein volles Potenzial entfalten kann. title: Senior Product Data Analyst- Consumer Growth
description: About the team SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way. As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn. We're looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes. You'll help answer questions such as: Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value? Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation? What drives repeat usage, retention and churn? Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance? How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments? If you're motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you. What you'll do Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation . Identify opportunities to improve conversion, customer value and sustainable growth using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analytics. Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis, customer insight and commercial understanding. Evaluate the performance of customer segments, markets, channels and product journeys, helping the team understand where growth opportunities and commercial trade-offs exist. Support decisions that improve key business outcomes, such as activation, conversion, repeat usage, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and revenue-related metrics. Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations. Define, monitor and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs, covering acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, churn and customer value. Design, execute and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer impact and commercial impact. Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actively use, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, performance risks and growth opportunities. Help Product Managers assess the expected impact of opportunities and evaluate whether product investments are delivering the intended customer and business outcomes. Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure KPI definitions, business logic and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable and trusted. Bring a curious eye to AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, to speed up insight generation, customer understanding and product measurement. You'll be great for this role if… You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar. You have hands-on experience with product analytics techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analysis. You understand the commercial drivers of a digital product, including customer acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, churn and customer lifetime value. You can connect customer behaviour and product performance to business outcomes, and use data to identify growth opportunities and inform prioritisation. You've worked on A/B tests or product experiments, with a solid grounding in the statistics behind them. You're proficient in a visualisation tool such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI, with a track record of building dashboards that stakeholders actually use. You can translate ambiguous product or business questions into structured analysis, and explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike. You're comfortable assessing trade-offs, challenging assumptions and making recommendations based on evidence. You're curious about how AI and emerging techniques can improve product measurement, experimentation, customer understanding and commercial decision-making. You're comfortable managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders, with strong prioritisation and a proactive communication style. This role does not support Visa sponsorship and candidates must have the right to work in the UK. Why you should join SumUp 🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central London Bridge location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. This involves an office-first setup 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success 🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education 🏥 Health matters: private health insurance, including optical and dental 🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta 💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%) 🛡 Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team About SumUp Be empowered to do more that matters. At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships. Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify. SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. You'll engage C-level and senior technical buyers, guiding them through cloud migration decisions and helping them understand why Bandwidth's carrier-grade platform is the right foundation for their communications strategy. voice, 911, messaging, and AI-enabled communications - and how they address enterprise operational and regulatory needs Stay close to competitor positioning, pricing, and GTM dynamics across CPaaS, CCaaS, and CX markets Provide informed feedback to internal teams on market positioning, competitive threats, and emerging enterprise buying patterns What You Need: Experience Enterprise software, CPaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, or telecom new logo sales experience Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding quota on complex six- and seven-figure ARR deals Demonstrated experience owning the full sales cycle - from self-sourced prospecting through commercial and contractual close Proven ability to build and convert pipeline in competitive, technically complex sales environments Consistent and demonstrable overachievement of sales goals and revenue targets Market Knowledge Deep understanding of the CPaaS, CCaaS, and CX market landscape - This role is ideal for someone with 10 years of enterprise sales experience and a deep understanding of the CPaaS, CCaaS, and CX market - including key platform players, partner ecosystems, and the buying dynamics within large enterprise organisations.

What You'll Do:

New Logo Acquisition & Pipeline Generation

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle from prospecting through commercial and contractual close, with a focus exclusively on new logo revenue
  • Consistently self-source pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting, partner-led account mapping, inbound qualification, and collaboration with the Sales Development team
  • Build and maintain a robust, accurate pipeline with high data integrity; proactively manage forecasting and opportunity hygiene
  • Execute territory plans that target high-potential enterprise accounts, identifying the right entry points and accelerating deal velocity

Channel Partner Collaboration

  • Develop and leverage relationships with channel partners to co-source, co-sell, and accelerate new logo opportunities
  • Map accounts collaboratively with partner organisations to identify mutual pipeline and avoid duplication

Executive Engagement & Deal Leadership

  • Navigate complex enterprise organisations, building relationships across C-suite, IT, operations, procurement, digital transformation, and CX leadership
  • Act as a strategic advisor, helping enterprise buyers understand cloud migration options, communication infrastructure decisions, and the long-term value of Bandwidth's platform
  • Lead complex contract negotiations across legal, security, finance, and procurement stakeholders
  • Serve as the internal deal orchestrator - aligning resources across Product, Legal, Solutions Engineering, and Operations to structure and close

Marketing & Lead Generation Alignment

  • Work closely with marketing and demand generation teams to ensure outbound campaigns align with territory priorities
  • Provide field-level feedback on messaging, positioning, and market signals to inform campaign effectiveness
  • Leverage marketing-qualified leads alongside self-sourced pipeline to maintain a healthy and diversified funnel

Market & Product Intelligence

  • Maintain a strong and current understanding of Bandwidth's full product portfolio - voice, 911, messaging, and AI-enabled communications - and how they address enterprise operational and regulatory needs
  • Stay close to competitor positioning, pricing, and GTM dynamics across CPaaS, CCaaS, and CX markets
  • Provide informed feedback to internal teams on market positioning, competitive threats, and emerging enterprise buying patterns

What You Need:

Experience

  • Enterprise software, CPaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, or telecom new logo sales experience
  • Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding quota on complex six- and seven-figure ARR deals
  • Demonstrated experience owning the full sales cycle - from self-sourced prospecting through commercial and contractual close
  • Proven ability to build and convert pipeline in competitive, technically complex sales environments
  • Consistent and demonstrable overachievement of sales goals and revenue targets

Market Knowledge

  • Deep understanding of the CPaaS, CCaaS, and CX market landscape - including key platform players, buying patterns, and enterprise decision drivers
  • Familiarity with leading enterprise CRM platforms and an understanding of how communications solutions integrate with or complement CRM ecosystems.
  • Solid knowledge of cloud migration dynamics, API-first platform architectures, and how enterprises evaluate and adopt communications infrastructure
  • Working knowledge of telecom fundamentals, including SIP, PSTN, voice infrastructure, and regulatory considerations such as E911

Sales Skills

  • Exceptional outbound prospecting ability with a track record of self-sourced pipeline generation
  • Ability to build relationships at director level and above across IT, operations, procurement, digital transformation, and CX functions
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills - working effectively with solutions engineering, legal, product, marketing, and partner teams
  • Commercial acumen and ability to construct and negotiate complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise agreements

Channel & Partner Experience

  • Experience collaborating with channel partners to close new logo opportunities
  • Understanding of how to engage partner organisations as a force multiplier in enterprise sales motions
  • Act as a trusted and credible partner-facing representative of Bandwidth in joint selling scenarios

Communication & Leadership

  • Ability to communicate complex technical and commercial value propositions clearly and compellingly at executive level
  • Strong pipeline and forecast discipline - comfortable operating in a data-driven, CRM-centric sales environment
  • BS/BA degree or equivalent enterprise sales experience

Bonus Points:

  • Prior exposure to Bandwidth's product portfolio or existing relationships with Bandwidth's channel partners
  • Experience selling into BPO, contact centre, or AI-enabled CX environments
  • Track record of selling into complex regulated industries where compliance, resiliency, and security are key buying criteria
  • Experience working alongside or within a structured Channel, Alliance, or Partner sales organisation

The Whole Person Promise: 

At Bandwidth, we're pretty proud of our corporate culture, which is rooted in our "Whole Person Promise." We promise all employees that they can have meaningful work AND a full life, and we provide a work environment geared toward enriching your body, mind, and spirit. How do we do that? Well…

  • Time-Off Embargo. When you take time off (of any kind!) you're embargoed from working. Bandmates and managers are not allowed to interrupt your time-off - not even with email.
  • Additional time-off can be earned throughout the year through volunteer hours and Bandwidth challenges.
  • "Mahalo moments" program grants additional time off for life's most important moments like graduations, buying a first home, getting married, wedding anniversaries (every five years), and the birth of a grandchild.
  • 90-Minute Workout Lunches, contribution to your monthly fitness subscription and unlimited virtual meetings with our very own nutritionist.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of <a href="https://www.hudl.com/blog/newsweek-top-100-global-most-loved-workplaces-2023">Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces</a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;<br><br>We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.<br><br>Ready to join us?</p> <div style="padding: 56.25% 0 0 0; position: relative;"><iframe style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0;" src="https://player.vimeo.com/video/1095624224?h=9e8cdc9dbe&amp;badge=0&amp;autopause=0&amp;player_id=0&amp;app_id=58479" width="" height=""></iframe></div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h2>Your Role</h2> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Senior Product Manager</strong> to join our Athlete Performance group. You’ll be responsible for a product suite that supports sports scientists and coaches in capturing and analysing athlete monitoring data—whether from wearables, optical tracking, or other data sources—to mitigate injury risk, optimise athletic performance, and track the physical development of athletes.&nbsp;</p> <p>As a <strong>Senior Product Manager</strong>, you’ll:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Grow our human performance business</strong>. You’ll work with a cross-functional team to create a coherent product strategy and vision, connecting it to the wider company strategy and effectively delivering against it. You’ll “quarterback” a key investment, with the goal of building products that customers love and use daily.</li> <li><strong>Advocate for the product.</strong> You’ll develop a deep understanding of our customers and our business needs, building trusting relationships with customers and senior internal stakeholders. As a Spa Therapist, you’ll combine expert technique with genuine hospitality, creating personalised experiences that leave every guest feeling renewed, cared for, and inspired.

Create calm. Thoughtful care. Memorable moments.

If you are passionate about wellbeing, take pride in your craft, and believe that true luxury lies in thoughtful, individual service, we’d love to hear your story. We are looking for therapists on a fulltime or casual basis.

What’s Our Story?

Inspired by the creativity and individuality of Shepherd’s Bush, Hotel Indigo celebrates authentic experiences and meaningful connections. Within our luxury Spa & Wellbeing offering, we create a tranquil retreat where guests and members can escape the pace of the city and reconnect with themselves.

Every treatment, every conversation, and every detail contributes to that journey, and our therapists are at the very heart of it.

Here’s what you can look forward to as our Spa Therapist:

Package on Offer:

Full-time – Basic Annual Salary: £30,000

  • 10% Commission on treatments
  • Commission on retail and service
  • Pension with company contributions
  • 50% discount in all our restaurants and Spa treatments across our properties
  • Team member and Friends & Family rates across our properties
  • IHG Employee rate across 6000 hotels globally
  • Complimentary stay after passing probation
  • Extensive discounts on our benefits platform
  • Access to a Healthcare Cashplan
  • Interest-free season ticket loan
  • Employee Assistance Programme – 24/7 online GP, mental health support, and wellbeing
  • Career development programmes and training opportunities
  • Bike to work scheme
  • Recommend a Friend incentive
  • Free meals on duty
  • Social squads and recognition schemes to make your voice heard and celebrate success

Casual – £14.42 hourly rate + only core benefits

Tasks

A Day in Your Neighbourhood

  • Deliver exceptional treatments – Perform luxurious face and body treatments, massages, facials, and wellbeing rituals with confidence, care, and impeccable attention to detail.
  • Create personalised experiences – Take time to understand every guest’s needs, tailoring consultations and recommendations to create truly memorable moments.
  • Share your expertise – Recommend retail products, treatments, and wellbeing experiences that enhance the guest journey while supporting commercial success.
  • Maintain a sanctuary of calm – Ensure treatment rooms are beautifully presented, fully stocked, and maintained to the highest standards throughout the day.
  • Work as one team – Collaborate closely with Spa Reception and fellow therapists to deliver a seamless experience from arrival through to departure.
  • Own the details – Keep consultation records, treatment notes, room checklists, and daily administration accurate and up to date.
  • Go beyond expectations – Handle guest requests with warmth and professionalism, ensuring every interaction reflects the standards of a luxury wellbeing destination.
  • Champion sustainability – Support environmentally conscious practices, reducing waste and embracing our commitment to responsible wellbeing.

Requirements

What’s Your Story?

You’re passionate about helping people feel their best and committed to delivering service that feels both personal and exceptional. You’ll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • A recognised spa therapy qualification (NVQ Level 3, CIBTAC, CIDESCO, VTCT or equivalent)
  • Previous experience within a luxury spa, wellness, or premium hospitality environment
  • Expertise in massage therapies, facials, and body treatments
  • Strong retail and product recommendation skills
  • Exceptional guest care and communication abilities
  • Knowledge of health & safety, hygiene, and spa operating procedures
  • A calm, polished, and professional presence
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays
  • A genuine passion for wellbeing and continuous learning

At Hotel Indigo, we believe every guest interaction should feel personal, authentic, and memorable. As a Spa Therapist, you’ll do more than deliver treatments, you’ll create moments of connection, restoration, and care that stay with guests long after they leave.

If you’re ready to bring your expertise, warmth, and passion for wellbeing to one of London’s newest luxury spa destinations, join Hotel Indigo & K West Spa Shepherd’s Bush and help us create extraordinary experiences, one treatment at a time.

HOW TO APPLY | Right to Work in the UK

Applicants must already have the legal right to live and work in the UK, as this role does not offer visa sponsorship.

Once your application is submitted, your details will be reviewed by the Hotel Indigo & K West Spa Shepherd’s Bush, hiring team, who will reach out to you directly if they would like to advance your application to the next stage. All applicants must have existing rights to work status in the UK.

About Hotel Indigo London K West Shepherd's Bush

K West Spa

A luxury spa is coming to Shepherd’s Bush.Opening late 2026.

Step into serenity at K West Spa, our natural haven that invites you to slow down, breathe deeply, and reconnect.

Rooted in a holistic, nature-inspired philosophy and using GROUND Wellbeing products, the Spa will feature an extensive Thermal Suite, spa garden, six beautifully designed treatment rooms, two couples’ suites, and serene relaxation spaces. It’s the ultimate reset.

Our brand-new luxury spa is undergoing final renovations and will be opening in Autumn 2026. Featuring modern wellness facilities, relaxing treatment rooms, and a hydrotherapy pool, we are excited to bring a premium spa experience to Shepherd’s Bush.

LocalStack - the Local Cloud Sandbox for Developers and AI Agents

We are a fast-growing Series A startup building cutting-edge technology to revolutionize cloud development processes and support highly efficient dev&test feedback loops. We’ve closed our last $25mil round in Q4 2024, led by Notable Capital, CRV and Heavybit.

LocalStack is a local cloud development platform. LocalStack makes it easier, faster, and less expensive for software teams to ship reliable, high-quality applications to the cloud.

The cloud was built to run software, not to support AI-native development workflows. As the world's leading local cloud development platform, LocalStack provides secure local sandboxes that simulate cloud environments, enabling AI agents and software developers to find and fix risks faster and more effectively than they can in the cloud.

Our customer base ranges from SMBs to Global Fortune 500 companies. Our clients include companies like NASA, Harness, IBM, Workday, Comcast, Apple, 3M, Block and many more.

We are sustainably growing our globally distributed teams across GTM, operations and engineering. In 2025 we almost doubled in size and continue to grow across all areas in 2026.

LocalStack is headquartered in Zurich/Switzerland 🇨🇭, with a small engineering office in Vienna/Austria 🇦🇹 and remote team members from 25 countries including 🇺🇸the US, 🇫🇷FR, 🇬🇧UK, 🇨🇦CA, 🇪🇸ES, and many more!

👉Check our Notion Candidate Handbook and our GitHub!

✅ What you will be working on/responsible for

  • Own the internal cloud infrastructure and serve as the primary point of contact for cloud operations and infrastructure requests.

  • Manage and continuously improve our multi-account cloud environment, ensuring security, governance, and compliance best practices are consistently applied.

  • Support and maintain compliance with SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001, ensuring audit evidence is prepared continuously rather than only during audit periods.

  • Operate and improve our identity and access management, including SSO, MFA, permissions, and joiner/mover/leaver processes.

  • Maintain and monitor self-hosted internal services, ensuring they meet agreed service levels and that vulnerabilities are tracked and resolved efficiently.

  • Monitor the security and health of our cloud environment through continuous posture management and proactive risk identification.

  • Own infrastructure cost management for the services under your responsibility and help other teams proactively identify cost or reliability risks before they become issues.

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to improve the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our cloud platform.

✅ Experience we expect you to bring to the role

  • Deep AWS experience at org level: Organizations, Control Tower, multi-account landing zones, IAM/SCPs, Security Hub/GuardDuty, VPC and multi-AZ networking

  • IaC as the only way infrastructure gets created - module design, state management, review and promotion between environments. Tool-agnostic, but real depth in at least one (Terraform/OpenTofu, CDK, Pulumi)

  • Understands how to evolve existing systems toward compliance - can look at a running estate and work out what has to change, in what order, to satisfy SOC 2 / ISO 27001. Having been through an audit or certification is a bonus, not a requirement

  • Internal workforce identity and access: IdP-backed SSO/MFA, centralised access management, automated joiner/mover/leaver

  • Self-hosting and operating shared internal tooling that other teams depend on -
    deploy, upgrade, back up, own the uptime

  • Observability and alerting design, plus on-call for a distributed team

  • Cloud cost management / FinOps fundamentals

  • Azure is a nice-to-have extension, not a requirement - AWS depth is what matters, but the estate is going multi-cloud so appetite for it counts

  • Bash, Python and/or Go for tooling. Comfortable with ambiguity in a remote-first environment, and happy being the first hire in a function

🌱 Values we hold in LocalStack

  • Care: we create with compassion. We prioritize empathy and understanding in every interaction. By genuinely caring for our team, customers, and community, we create an environment where people thrive and impactful work flourishes

  • Ownership: we own the outcome. We take responsibility for our work and are passionate about its impact. We foster autonomy, inspire ambition, encourage ownership, and empower everyone to unlock their potential and make an impact.

  • Openness: we build trust together. We build trust through open communication and honest feedback. By sharing ideas and embracing diverse perspectives, we create stronger, more connected teams that work toward shared goals.

  • Courage: we dare to innovate. We embrace bold challenges and take calculated risks to move the needle. We step outside our comfort zones, experiment fearlessly, and turn setbacks into springboards for growth.

  • Excellence: we chase the extraordinary. We chase excellence by pushing boundaries and delivering results that go beyond the ordinary, constantly raising the bar and striving for greatness in everything we do. Excellence is not just the outcome, itʼs how we approach every task with purpose, passion, and a commitment to delivering exceptional value.

Sounds like a good match?

We'd love to hear from you! Join us in shaping the future of cloud development at LocalStack.

You'll be selling a product, not a service, into CISOs, security engineers and AppSec leads, which means the pitch has to work on its own merits rather than on brand recognition. This is a full-cycle closing role: you'll run discovery, demo and negotiation yourself, with support from the CRO on the harder deals while you build that muscle. You'll carry mid-market opportunities to start, working alongside SDR-sourced pipeline as well as your own prospecting, with a clear path to Senior Account Executive as your quota, deal complexity and independence grow. Generate some of your own pipeline alongside SDR support, prospecting into a clearly defined ideal customer profile. Run structured discovery calls solo, identifying pain and priorities for your primary buyer. Close mid-market deals with negotiation support from the CRO as you build experience with more complex procurement. Maintain your own weekly pipeline and forecast, developing commit accuracy over time. Work SDR and Customer Success handoffs as directed, keeping CRM records clean and up to date. Real consultative selling instinct: you'd rather understand a prospect's problem than run a script at them. Comfortable prospecting and selling into accounts with little existing awareness of Cytix, energised by the challenge of a cold or lightly-worked start. Visible drive and competitiveness, and a willingness to take on unfamiliar deal types or buyer personas when asked. Genuinely bright and inquisitive: good follow-up questions come naturally to you, and you're genuinely curious about the product and the security market, including how software gets built and secured. Drawn to a business where new challenges show up daily; you want to take ownership of them and lean in, rather than needing everything mapped out in advance. Comfortable taking yourself out of your comfort zone when a deal or a buyer is unfamiliar territory. What you'll get Unlimited Holidays! Share options - If Cytix wins, you should too. Enhanced maternity pay. Pension - 8% (3% employer, 5% employee) Private Healthcare (inc. dental, optical and hearing) Octopus car scheme - Drive electric through salary sacrifice Dog-friendly office . Inclusivity as standard - A team where you can do your best work as yourself, no asterisks. About Cytix Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on. That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words. We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it. Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics. Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on. description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. 🏡 Where you'll fit in: KrakenFlex is the flexibility arm of the Kraken group, built to put a big green dent in global carbon emissions by rewriting how electricity grids operate. We stabilize the grid and help renewables come online much faster by managing the second-by-second balance of clean power. Right now, our platform connects nearly one million assets worldwide, putting over 6GW of live load under our direct control. Behind the scenes, that means handling massive technical scale: solving complex optimization problems in real time and processing 15 billion data readings a day from the latest green technologies, ensuring the grid stays reliable without relying on old fossil-fuel backup plants. The next phase of our journey involves monumental growth. Currently operational across multiple countries, we are poised for further global expansion, scaling our asset base and tackling unique grid challenges in new territories. Our mission is to integrate an increasingly diverse array of green flexibility assets while ensuring our market-leading platform remains exceptionally stable and performant. What is Optimisation in Flex? The Optimisation chapter is the mathematical and algorithmic engine of the KrakenFlex platform. While other chapters manage physical asset connectivity or ingest market signals, this domain is responsible for the intelligence that decides exactly what every asset should do, second by second, to maximise both grid stability and financial returns. The teams within this chapter build and maintain the real-time dispatch engines, predictive forecasting models, and algorithmic solvers that handle massive multi-asset portfolios. This involves translating complex market rules, physical asset constraints (like battery degradation curves, state-of-charge limits, and ramp rates), and fluctuating price signals into optimised execution strategies. The defining challenge for this chapter is scaling computational performance alongside our rapid asset growth. Running complex, multi-variable mathematical models in tight real-time windows requires immense efficiency. The core tension lies in balancing the demand from data science and quantitative engineering to introduce increasingly sophisticated models with the strict platform requirement for absolute reliability, low latency, and cost-effective cloud compute. Ultimately, this chapter must move away from bespoke optimisation routines tailored to individual markets or asset types. Your goal is to architect a highly performant, modular optimisation core that uses standard abstract layers, allowing us to roll out new algorithms or expand into new global territories without rewriting the underlying engine. 🚀 What you’ll own: The Flex platform is built on autonomous Chapters, which are collections of specialists focused on delivering a core service or business outcome, defined by the unchanging nature of the energy business (independent of technology, hardware, or regional differences). A Head of Engineering leading a Chapter is a senior leadership role combining strong product thinking, engineering judgement, operational awareness, and people leadership. They manage managers and senior individual contributors, helping teams own their product surfaces, make sound trade-offs, and deliver reliably. This role requires influencing beyond its formal remit, spotting cross-team patterns, clarifying ownership and decision-making, and driving initiatives to turn recurring issues into visible actions with owners, dates, and measures of success. Ultimately, they maintain the technical vision for their specific area, ensuring services are appropriately owned, maintained, and aligned with Flex's sustainable growth. Managing the leads. Maintaining the technical vision for a given area. The overall team architecture Ensuring the services in that area are owned and maintained appropriately. Ensuring that product features are built in a way that scales, is cost-effective, and is in line with the vision for a product area. Ensuring the appropriate level of quality and resilience, with a specific focus on reducing system incidents and improving stability. Ensuring appropriate tech debt is prioritised to support sustainable delivery. Potentially managing a squad (team) as well. 🧠 What you’ll bring to the party: You’ll be a strong fit if you have experience leading engineering teams across multiple squads, teams or product areas in a complex product environment. A collaborative product and engineering mindset: you care about customer outcomes, product strategy, technical quality and the people needed to make the work real. Strong judgement in ambiguity: you can separate urgent from important, make trade-offs explicit and help teams move without pretending all uncertainty has disappeared. A track record of influencing beyond your reporting line and team, building trust with senior stakeholders and helping teams reach decisions when ownership is shared. A bias for action and improvement: when you see a recurring issue, you turn it into the smallest useful action that starts making the system better. Reliability in driving initiatives: people can trust that when you take ownership, the work keeps moving, dependencies are managed and decisions are followed through. Strong people leadership practice, including coaching, direct feedback, performance management, delegation, psychological safety and development of future leaders. Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. title: Engineering Manager - Experimentation
description: Think it, build it, ship it, tweak it" is at the core of Spotify's product development approach. In the Experimentation product area we are providing Spotify and external customers with Confidence, our platform to quickly and safely iterate through ideas, learn from them and make informed decisions for better products. At Spotify, experimentation touches almost all of our functions from marketing via content management to consumer products, and we’re running several thousands of tests every year. Through confidence, we 're sharing all our findings and practices with more companies as a commercial SaaS product. The team you will manage is a skilled and highly engaged group of engineers that are distributed over Europe. As an Engineering manager, you will coach them individually and as a team, maintaining their strong team culture and helping them thrive and and grow. Your technical experience provides mentorship and guidelines to the team, which ensures quality and timeliness of your deliveries. Your leadership promotes creativity, collaboration and courage, which forms a kind and productive team with a high bar for quality and pace of delivery. What You’ll Do You will hire, coach and develop the careers of a team of engineers. You will be responsible for high-quality deliveries. You will partner with product managers to support with prioritizations and product visions. You will support the engineering team and work with Staff engineers to formulate the technical strategy needed to deliver on our vision. You will do hands on engineering work from time to time. In the end, your primary goal is to support a highly effective engineering team delivering an amazing product. Who You Are You thrive when developing great people, not just great products and cultivating a strong engineering culture in an agile environment. You are skilled in collaborating on and developing distributed systems that can scale to millions of users. You have experience with data warehouses and data processing at scale. You have worked on commercial SaaS products in the past and have hands on experience taking features from zero to one. You are a brave learner and see unfamiliar territories as an opportunity to grow. You are a senior individual contributor (or has been) with strong people skills and leadership experience. You’re passionate about software engineering best practices and love to have an impact on large-scale tech problems. You care deeply about quality of the products your working and, and hold people to a high standard. Naturally, you harness AI as a tool that helps you be more effective at your work. Where You’ll Be This role is based in Stockholm. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.   At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Company Overview</strong></p> <p>Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.</p> <p>Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.</p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.</p> <p><strong>Job Overview</strong></p> <p>Jensen Hughes is a market leading forensic investigation company, comprised of highly experienced investigators committed to delivering technical excellence.&nbsp; Operating throughout the UK, Ireland and overseas, we investigate the origin and cause of fires and explosions and other accidents or failures on land and at sea. Our clients trust us to respond rapidly and deliver conclusive reports, robust evidence and expert testimony of the highest technical standard in courts throughout the world.</p> <p>A forensic investigation includes establishing the root cause of an event and determining the likelihood of a recovery from a third party or the repudiation of a claim on an insurance policy because the policyholder has failed to fulfil obligations under the contract of insurance.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Senior Fire Investigator to join our highly qualified team, based in Ireland.</p> <p>&nbsp;This role will involve:</p> <ul> <li>Attending incident scenes, documenting and collecting evidence, interviewing witnesses</li> <li>Acting as investigator in the investigation of the origin, cause and development of more complex cases</li> <li>Liaising with experts representing other interested parties</li> <li>Producing consistently high quality, detailed and accurate technical reports</li> <li>Providing expert witness evidence, where required</li> <li>Utilising Jensen Hughes’ case management system to record all case-related activity, in line with SLA requirements</li> <li>Attending joint examinations, utilising the skills of specialists where necessary</li> <li>Maintaining technical knowledge and skills through Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in content design or UX writing, with a portfolio that shows work on both sides: copy shipped inside a product, and marketing pages you wrote or restructured

  • Real in-product examples. Onboarding flows, empty states, error messaging, upgrade moments - the words people hit when something is confusing or has gone wrong. Tell us what changed as a result

  • Real web examples. Pages where the copy carries the argument, not just the headline.

  • The ability to look at an already-designed page and say precisely where the message gets lost on a skim, then rewrite it

  • A clear point of view on voice. You can describe a brand's voice and point to copy where you delivered a message in it

  • Comfort working at the pace of a design team that ships daily, in Figma, alongside product designers and PMs rather than downstream of them

  • Comfort partnering with an external design agency as well as internal marketing and design stakeholders

  • Ideally - content strategy chops. Strategy and SEO aren't the core scope here, but the instincts show up in the work

If you're strong on only one side of this, apply anyway. We know we're describing a rare combination. If you're exceptional at in-product writing and have never touched a marketing site, or you're a brilliant web writer who has never written an error message, we still want to see your work. Tell us which side you're great at and we'll take it from there.

In one sentence: Make Lovable sound like one company, in the product and on the website.

  • Own the copy in the moments that decide whether someone sticks: first run in the editor, empty states, failed and partial builds, upgrade and credit prompts

How we hire

  1. Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with a recruiter.

  2. Send us two pieces of work: ideally one from inside a product and one from the web, or two from whichever side you're strongest on.

  • Fluency in spoken and written English. Ability to draft written materials to a professional standard with minimal review and excellent verbal communications skills 
  • Strong project management skills, including an ability to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines. 
  • Demonstrable experience of interacting and working with senior business professionals.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Business Operations
description: About Deliveroo Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the most rapidly expanding industries in the world: a complex, always-on, three-sided marketplace that impacts millions of people every day. Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. The Team BizOps is the team that keeps its finger on the pulse of business performance: continuously, rigorously, and across multiple dimensions at once. We turn raw operational and financial data into actionable intelligence, surfacing what is happening, why it is happening, and what to expect next , for the operators, executives, and functional teams who run the business day to day. We are not a reporting function that produces outputs on request. We work continuously, proactively watching, delivering, and questioning whether the signal is real, acting as "first responders" to surprising deviations from expectation and using what we learn to drive faster, better decision-making for the business at large. Our work spans the full stack of analytics: from the warehouse models that make metrics trustworthy, to the monitoring systems that catch problems early, to the reports and dashboards that make performance visible, to the deep-dive investigations that explain what the numbers mean and what we should do about it. We anchor our analysis to the right reference points: how performance compares to plan, to prior periods, and to what we'd expect, and we bring causal rigour when the business needs to know whether an action actually worked. The culture within the team is informal, fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the level of senior stakeholder exposure, progression in the team can be fast. The Role Deliveroo is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to join BizOps, based in our London HQ (hybrid, minimum three days per week in the office). This role is largely project-based: starting from a strategic or performance question, you'll combine data, business context, and structured problem-solving to provide the insights that drive decision-making at a global level with senior stakeholders. You will own delivery end-to-end, from the messy, ambiguous question to a rigorous, trustworthy, and actionable answer. You'll be equally comfortable building the systems that make performance visible and going deep on the investigations that explain it. One week you might diagnose why a key market has moved away from plan; the next, identify the drivers behind a change in customer or operational performance; the next, build monitoring that helps teams spot and understand emerging issues earlier. Success in this role requires building effective working relationships across Deliveroo, particularly with international markets, as well as the Data Science, Operations, Commercial, and Finance teams. What You'll Be Doing Answer the questions that matter, continuously. Maintain a rigorous view on business performance: Are we on track against our goals? What's changed? How does this compare with what we expected? What should we expect next? Then go further: Why is it happening, what matters most, and what should we do about it?” Own delivery end-to-end. Independently identify, define, and deliver impactful work aligned with business goals, operating with minimal guidance to ship fast, high-quality solutions. Navigate ambiguity. Deconstruct broad, ambiguous problem spaces into structured analytical roadmaps, and understand how your work intersects with adjacent systems and teams. Build for scale, not one-offs. Build the pipelines, models, dashboards, monitoring, and investigative tooling that make performance visible and reliable. Automate wherever possible; redoing analyses by hand is slow and error-prone. Measure impact with discipline. Design measurement strategies from simple A/B tests to quasi-experimental designs (synthetic control, difference-in-differences, event studies) when trials aren't feasible, always with conservative, assumption-explicit language. Be a first responder. Surface deviations before they become escalations, and be just as willing to give the confident "this is noise, no action needed" as the alarm. Communicate to influence. Translate complex findings into clear, simple, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences that shape roadmaps and decisions. Raise the bar. Contribute to the broader Analytics community, improve shared approaches and best practices, and help build data literacy across the business. What You'll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate brings strong expertise in some of these areas and the curiosity to grow in others: Experience in an analytical or data science role, such as data analytics, data science, forecasting, planning, strategy analytics, or a similar discipline. Experience in logistics, e-commerce, marketplaces, or another fast-moving, customer-focused business is useful but not essential. Proficiency with SQL and a scripting language such as Python or R, alongside experience with BI or visualisation tooling such as Looker, Tableau, or similar. Comfortable using modern AI-assisted tools to work efficiently while maintaining high standards of accuracy and reproducibility. A pragmatic approach to problem-solving: you can balance analytical rigour with speed, adapt your approach to the importance of the decision, and focus effort where it will have the greatest impact. Effective problem-solving: you can take an ambiguous question, identify the underlying problem or decision, develop hypotheses, and use data and business context to reach a clear point of view. Experience with experimentation and/or causal inference is a strong plus: the ability to unpick insights and steer strategic decisions. Excellent communication skills, in person, in writing, and in code, with the ability to translate business needs into analytical problems and complex findings into simple recommendations. Driven, hard-working, and agile. BizOps sits at the centre of a fast-growing business; we move quickly to scale at pace. London-based, with a minimum of three days per week in the office. Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale : work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day. 🌱 See your impact, fast : ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment. 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership : take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support. 🌎 A culture built for builders : high standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning. 💰 Share in the success you help create : competitive salary and equity, so you're rewarded for the impact you make. We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine; our interview typically includes 3 to 4 stages. Workplace & Benefits At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits across areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific; please ask your recruiter for more information. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are: your gender, race, sexuality, religion, or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry. We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. If you have a disability or long-term health condition, or require any reasonable adjustments to apply or fairly participate in the interview process, please let us know; we'll make every effort to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed. The culture within the team is informal, fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the level of senior stakeholder exposure, progression in the team can be fast.

The Role

Deliveroo is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to join BizOps, based in our London HQ (hybrid, minimum three days per week in the office).

This role is largely project-based: starting from a strategic or performance question, you'll combine data, business context, and structured problem-solving to provide the insights that drive decision-making at a global level with senior stakeholders. You will own delivery end-to-end, from the messy, ambiguous question to a rigorous, trustworthy, and actionable answer.

You'll be equally comfortable building the systems that make performance visible and going deep on the investigations that explain it. One week you might diagnose why a key market has moved away from plan; the next, identify the drivers behind a change in customer or operational performance; the next, build monitoring that helps teams spot and understand emerging issues earlier.

Success in this role requires building effective working relationships across Deliveroo, particularly with international markets, as well as the Data Science, Operations, Commercial, and Finance teams.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Answer the questions that matter, continuously. Maintain a rigorous view on business performance: Are we on track against our goals? What's changed? How does this compare with what we expected? What should we expect next? Then go further: Why is it happening, what matters most, and what should we do about it?”

  • Own delivery end-to-end. Independently identify, define, and deliver impactful work aligned with business goals, operating with minimal guidance to ship fast, high-quality solutions.

  • Navigate ambiguity. Deconstruct broad, ambiguous problem spaces into structured analytical roadmaps, and understand how your work intersects with adjacent systems and teams.

  • Build for scale, not one-offs. Build the pipelines, models, dashboards, monitoring, and investigative tooling that make performance visible and reliable. Automate wherever possible; redoing analyses by hand is slow and error-prone.

  • Measure impact with discipline. Design measurement strategies from simple A/B tests to quasi-experimental designs (synthetic control, difference-in-differences, event studies) when trials aren't feasible, always with conservative, assumption-explicit language.

  • Be a first responder. Surface deviations before they become escalations, and be just as willing to give the confident "this is noise, no action needed" as the alarm.

  • Communicate to influence. Translate complex findings into clear, simple, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences that shape roadmaps and decisions.
